purpose: Teach: 三角形/水晶/ルネサンス/ナベ/円盤/ボールペン/鳥居/フルート

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、三角形の問題、解けたろ?
lines.en: Riku, you figured out that triangle problem, right?
lines.style: Quick, testing probe. Leans in slightly. Warm curiosity with an edge of 'I want to know what you think.' Light and forward-moving.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お土産で水晶のキーホルダー買ったろ?桜
lines.en: You bought that crystal keychain as a souvenir, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting back with a half-smile in the voice. Turns the question around like a mirror. Softer than the words suggest — genuine interest masked as teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、美術の授業でルネサンスやったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you did Renaissance in art class, yeah?
lines.style: Persistent but not pushy. Testing him, enjoying the back-and-forth. Slight uptick of amusement in the delivery — she knows he's dodging.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家のナベパーティ楽しかったろ?桜
lines.en: The hot pot party at your place was fun, wasn't it? Sakura.
lines.style: Softer this time. Genuine recollection in the voice — a real moment underneath the habit of turning it back on her. Slightly exposed, then catching himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、UFOの円盤型に夢中だな
lines.en: Riku, you're really into those UFO disc shapes.
lines.style: Wry observation, light teasing edge. Caught him in his thing. Knowing, warm underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで赤のボールペン使うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't use red pens on tests, Sakura.
lines.style: Practical advice wrapped in what sounds like lecturing but isn't. Protective note beneath — he worries. Simple delivery, no performance. Just saying it because it matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、初詣で鳥居くぐったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you went through the shrine gate at New Year's, right?
lines.style: Return to the original rhythm. Testing him again, settling back into the familiar dance. Lighter now — she's found her footing. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、吹奏楽でフルートやってんだろ?桜
lines.en: You play flute in the band, don't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Close and warm. The turning-back pattern has softened into something like affection. He's stopped deflecting and is just sitting with her. Eyes meeting. Small smile in the voice.
